modes.cloud: Managed Cloud (cloud_managed / ManagedGateway or ManagedNative): AGI-managed provider access or hosted compute. One logical product across Desktop Cloud, Web, and Mobile Cloud sharing identical backend behavior. Public alpha, open by default (founder decision 2026-06-27); AGI_MANAGED_COMPUTE_PRIVATE_BETA is an incident-response kill-switch only. A distinct trust boundary: Local/BYOK are never silently routed into it.
modes.local: Local Mode (local_only / Local): runs on-device or via a local host/runtime. Completely isolated — never talks to AGI Cloud (no telemetry, sync, or provider proxy). BYOK lives only here, at no markup. Desktop Local and Mobile Local store everything locally; data leaves the device only via explicit, consented transfer. Never requires an AGI account.
modes.hybrid: Hybrid: capability/cost/health/trust-aware routing across Local, BYOK, and Managed with failover, fallback, and offline mode. Boundary crossings are always explicit and consented (Local->BYOK is a reviewed fork with context selection, secret scan, payload preview, provider label, and consent). Smart routing must explain its choice and never silently cross a trust boundary.
